svg.title: Riju gives a commuter a possible duplicate-record referral to the welfare counter.
svg.desc: At the platform exit, two separate source cards surface as a possible match. Riju does not link them; he tells the commuter that the staffed counter must ask for confirmation while Vale and Cecil observe.
svg.text: Page 28, panel 5 · Platform-exit wide shot following one commuter towards a welfare prompt

text.tspan: The system surfaces a possible duplicate identity
without deciding it, and Riju directs the commuter
to the counter for informed review.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
